target_customer: Private K-12 schools in Nigeria (fee collection) and their parents (installment financing and savings)
problem: Parents face lump-sum school fee bills and schools wait weeks for payment. Schoolable pays fees upfront and lets parents repay monthly, giving schools most of their fees early.
business_model: Fintech: fee financing with interest or fees on repayment plans, plus school software for collection and payroll

founders.name: Henry Chibuzo (also listed as Henry Nnalue)
founders.background_notes: Sources give two surnames for the CEO; not reconciled.

founders.name: Angela Essien
founders.background_notes: Background not found in sources reviewed.

technical_complexity.rationale: A parent app, school dashboard and payment integrations are standard engineering. The harder part was credit underwriting and collections, which is financial operations more than technology.

defensibility.rationale: School relationships and a lending book give some stickiness, but nothing structural stops a bank or another fintech copying fee installment plans.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying the model in 2019 to 2020. Later entrants such as TermFund and EduPali appeared after 2020.

market_need_then: Private schools in Nigeria bill fees in large termly lumps. A 2020 article cites 350 schools using the platform. A company-sourced claim from a later entrant cites 13,000+ registered private schools and large annual fee flows.

branding.domain_note: Company site is schoolable.co, not a .com (website field).

rebrands.why: One founder profile says the product grew out of AllPro and took the Schoolable name by Demo Day; no stated reason.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found. Coverage in 2020 still headlined it as AllPro's Schoolable, which suggests the name was not yet established.

pivots.from: AllPro school management and fee tools
pivots.to: Schoolable, school fee financing and savings
pivots.why: Founders narrowed focus on education fee financing, per one founder profile.

outcome_analysis: Schoolable stayed small and Active, with about 10 staff and a reported 350 schools in 2020. Public funding is limited to roughly 190 thousand dollars of pre-seed money, with no verified later round, so it has not shown the growth or capital needed for a venture outcome, though no failure is reported either. The business depends on lending to parents in a high-inflation market, which stresses unit economics, but no source states problems.
notes: Funding sources conflict: StartupList total 190K, PitchBook 500K total with a 350K seed in Jan 2019, Seedtable 500K seed dated Jan 2021. Only the 150K and 40K rounds (consistent with the 190K total) are recorded; the rest are unverified. Founder surname conflict between Chibuzo and Nnalue. Founded 2018 (Digest Africa) versus 2019 (YC). Company website not fetched. No outcome event found for this Active company. No dated competitor sources from 2019 found.
